The '''Burna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Burna Trade Route]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Burna system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-6.<ref name="TEA" />
